#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

LAUNCH_COMMIT="${1:?Expected committed source hash}"
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:?Submit from the experiment worktree}"
python3 scaffolds/launch/frozen.py check --launch-commit "$LAUNCH_COMMIT" \
  --experiment shared_kernel_validation --scaffold transformer

PYTHON="$PWD/scaffolds/transformer/.venv/bin/python"
RECORD="$PWD/scaffolds/transformer/validation/runs/fixed-square-m2-h100"
LOGS="$PWD/scaffolds/transformer/validation/logs/fixed-square-m2-h100"
mkdir -p "$RECORD" "$LOGS"
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD" JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-4}"
export CUDA_HOME="$PWD/scaffolds/transformer/.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/nvidia/cuda_nvcc"
source scaffolds/transformer/launchers/kennel_runtime.sh

"$PYTHON" - "$RECORD/metadata.json" "$LAUNCH_COMMIT" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime

import jax

from scaffolds.launch.frozen import frozen_hash

root = Path.cwd()
commit = sys.argv[2]
devices = jax.devices()
metadata = {
    "source_commit": commit,
    "home_cluster": "kennel",
    "artifact_root": str(root),
    "hostname": socket.gethostname(),
    "started_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "slurm_job_id": os.environ["SLURM_JOB_ID"],
    "partition": os.environ["SLURM_JOB_PARTITION"],
    "gpu_count": len(devices),
    "gpu_type": devices[0].device_kind,
    "devices": [str(device) for device in devices],
    "hardware": subprocess.check_output(
        ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=name,uuid,driver_version", "--format=csv,noheader"],
        text=True,
    ).splitlines(),
    "runtime": {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in (
        "CUDA_HOME", "JAX_PLATFORMS", "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "TRANSFORMER_HOST_STAGING",
        "NCCL_P2P_DISABLE", "XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE",
    )},
    "frozen_execution_set_sha256": frozen_hash(root, commit, "shared_kernel_validation", "transformer"),
    "lock_sha256": hashlib.sha256((root / "scaffolds/transformer/uv.lock").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "resolved_attention_backend": "fused",
    "data": "Deterministic synthetic BF16 near-root vectors and seeded test arrays; no external dataset",
    "selected_checkpoints": [],
}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(metadata, sort_keys=True))
PY

"$PYTHON" - <<'PY'
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

from scaffolds.transformer.tests.test_fixed_square_factors import _attention, _near_root_inputs

q, k, v = _near_root_inputs()

@jax.jit
def diagnostic(q, k, v):
    output, pullback = jax.vjp(lambda q, k, v: _attention(q, k, v, backend="fused"), q, k, v)
    return output, pullback(jnp.ones_like(output))

output, gradients = diagnostic(q, k, v)
q_max = float(jnp.max(jnp.abs(gradients[0].astype(jnp.float32))))
k_max = float(jnp.max(jnp.abs(gradients[1].astype(jnp.float32))))
print(f"near_root_one_key_output={output.tolist()} q_gradient_abs_max={q_max} k_gradient_abs_max={k_max}")
assert q_max <= 1e-2 and k_max <= 1e-2
PY

"$PYTHON" -m pytest -c scaffolds/transformer/pyproject.toml --import-mode=importlib -q -m gpu \
  scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_fixed_square_factors_fused.py \
  scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_normalized_polynomial_fused_attention.py \
  --junitxml="$LOGS/tests.xml"
